slot.brief: Identify which of four aldehydes undergoes Cannizzaro reaction — check for absence of α-hydrogens.

stem: Which of the following aldehydes undergoes the Cannizzaro reaction?

verdicts.working: Cannizzaro reaction is shown by aldehydes without an α-hydrogen. 2,2-Dimethylpropanal has no α-hydrogen; the others do.

working:
Cannizzaro reaction requires an aldehyde with no $\alpha$-hydrogen.
2,2-Dimethylpropanal, $(\text{CH}_3)_3\text{CCHO}$, has no $\alpha$-hydrogen.

Independent check: Cannizzaro reaction is shown by aldehydes without an α-hydrogen. 2,2-Dimethylpropanal has no α-hydrogen; the others do.
solution: Cannizzaro reaction is shown by aldehydes having no $\alpha$-hydrogen. In 2,2-dimethylpropanal, $(\mathrm{CH}_3)_3\mathrm{CCHO}$, the carbon adjacent to $-\mathrm{CHO}$ has no hydrogen.
